title: Data assimilation section
description: Configuration for the surface OI and upper-air assimilation chain.

surface.description: If true (default), Run surface OI chain.

upper_air.description: If true, the upper-air 3D-Var chain (UpperAir family with OopsVar) is added after the surface OI chain. Set to false to run surface DA only (CANARI chain without 3D-Var), which is useful for refining the surface analysis independently or for surface-only experiments.

obs_dir.description: Root directory of pre-processed observation files.

obs_types_surface.description: Observation types used for the surface analysis.

obs_types_3dvar.description: Observation types used for the 3D-Var upper-air analysis.

obs_sources.description: Per-obstype source definitions. Keys are obstype names.

candidates.description: List of filename templates to try. Supports {ymdrr}, {yyyy}, {mm}, {dd}, {rr} placeholders.

local_name.description: Filename BATOR/OBSCONVERT expects in the working directory. Same placeholders as candidates.

source_dir.description: Directory to search for files (overrides da.obs_dir for this obstype).

format.description: File format string passed to BATOR (e.g. OBSOUL, BUFR, NETCDF, GRIB).

bator_name.description: Internal BATOR obs-type identifier written to refdata/batormap. Defaults to the obstype key.

scratch.description: Scratch directory for in-cycle DA intermediate files (ODB, analyses, VARBC).

const_dir.description: Directory containing DA constant files (B-matrix, RTTOV coefficients, blacklists, etc.).

guess_dir.description: Directory where the short-range background (first guess) is stored. Expected files: <guess_dir>/YYYY/MM/DD/guess.YYYYMMDDRR[.gz]

analysis_dir.description: Archive directory for the final DA analysis fields. Used by the Forecast when do_assimilation is true.

varbc_dir.description: Directory for variational bias-correction (VARBC) files. Expected: <varbc_dir>/YYYY/MM/DD/VARBC.cycle_<RR>

rttov_coef_dir.description: Directory containing RTTOV satellite channel coefficient files.

nbpool.description: Number of ODB pools (NBPOOL) used by BATOR / SHUFFLE.

openmp.description: Enable OpenMP threading in MASTERODB screening step.

obsoul_merge_script.description: Path to the obsoul_merge.pl script (used by ObsPrep to merge obsoul files).

obs_provider.description: Selects the active observation provider block from da.providers. 'UWC' (default) and 'LACE' are the typical values; any string matching a key under da.providers is valid.

bator_window_len.description: BATOR assimilation window length in minutes (BATOR_WINDOW_LEN / param.cfg WINDOW_LENGTH).

bator_window_shift.description: BATOR assimilation window shift in minutes (BATOR_WINDOW_SHIFT / param.cfg WINDOW_SHIFT). Typically negative (window starts before analysis time).

bator_slot_len.description: BATOR slot length in minutes (BATOR_SLOT_LEN). 0 (default) activates single-slot mode.

bator_nbslot.description: Number of BATOR time slots (BATOR_NBSLOT / param.cfg NSLOT).

obs_step.description: Time step of observation files in the archive (minutes). When > 0, ObsPrep collects files from all archive slots that fall within the assimilation window [basetime+window_shift, basetime+window_shift+window_len] and merges them. Set to 60 for hourly archives (LACE convention). Set to 0 (default) to search only the basetime slot.

gpssol_stations.description: List of GPS station IDs to include in list_gpssol (BATOR GPS-ZTD input). When set, Bator writes list_gpssol from this list. When absent, the file is linked from da.namelist_dir if available.

oops.description: Settings for the OOPS-based 3D-Var (OopsVar task). Used when da.upper_air = true.

namelist_dir.description: Directory containing OOPS namelist templates (namelist_oopsminim, oops_3dvar.json, namelist_bmatrix_3dvar, namelist_observations*, namelist_*_model, namelist_gom_setup*, namelist_oops_write_spec, namelist_write_analysis, namelist_standard_geometry, namelist_geometry_tENS, iasichannels).

niter.description: Number of minimization inner-loop iterations ({niter} placeholder in namelist_oopsminim).

nsimu.description: Number of simulations in the minimization ({nsimu}).

nproma.description: NPROMA block size for OOPS geometry ({NPROMA}, {nproma}). Negative values mean auto-sizing.

nbpool.description: Number of ODB pools for the upper-air 3D-Var (OOVAR). Separate from da.nbpool which controls Canari/BATOR.
